correctness.comparison: recursive equal shape; finite numbers; math.isclose using trusted manifest atol/rtol; exact by default

counters.cases: accepted testcases of the profile pass only
counters.reason: the Tensix counters are compiled into the kernels (PROFILE_PERF_COUNTERS); their read-out perturbs the kernel window, so the ranked device time comes from the pass without them

device.cache_state: one container per submission and pass; first invocation and three warmups precede the samples; no explicit cache flush
device.derived_ns: cycles * 1000 / recorded CSV MHz; clock variation not corrected
device.repeatability_check: first and final output, not every invocation
device.scope: same device/core/RISC kernel cycles and same-core envelopes; stage occurrence aligned within sample

host.cache_state: one container per submission and pass; warm program cache; first invocation and three warmups precede the samples; no explicit L1/DRAM cache flush
host.measured_in: the profiler-instrumented pass, around the same invocations whose device cycles are captured
host.repeatability_check: first and final output, not every invocation
host.ttnn_scope: Python solve(a,b) plus device synchronization; allocation inside solve included

ttlang: profile: every testcase in one container (correctness, host and device timing)
counters: the accepted testcases in a second container
ttnn_metalium: host, device and (TT-Lang only) counters passes, one fresh container per testcase and pass

resources.cpuset: deployment supplied and recorded; does not isolate OS/IRQ tasks
resources.wall_timeout_includes: TT-Lang: per testcase inside the shared container, measured from its start marker; ttnn/Metalium: container startup, initialization, JIT, transfers, benchmark and output, per pass

scheduler.external_exclusion: OJ advisory lock and known Docker device consumers only
scheduler.queue: Hydro priority queue; broker records receipt, not enqueue
scheduler.submission_device_ids: one chip of the pool per TT-Lang submission

statistics.bootstrap: 1000 resamples deterministic seed=0; assumes IID despite potentially correlated samples; diagnostic only

storage.attempt_identity: new UUID hex for each broker receipt including rejudge
storage.integrity: SHA-256 inventory, not a cryptographic signature or write-once medium
storage.retention: indefinite until manual administrator removal; no automatic source publication
storage.timestamps: UTC wall time plus host monotonic_ns; no fabricated enqueue or cross-host clock alignment
